title: Verify the sales order created by the Sales Order Agent matches its source email
preconditions: SANDBOX ONLY. The FastTrack Sales Order Agent has processed a test email in this environment. Replace {customer} and {orderRef} with the customer account and the reference from that email. The agent writes real sales orders, so never run this against production.

steps.action: Log into D365 F&O and switch to the USMF legal entity.
Navigate to Modules > Sales and marketing > Sales orders > All sales orders.
Filter the grid by Customer account = '{customer}' and find the order carrying the reference '{orderRef}'.
steps.expected: Exactly one sales order is found for that customer and reference.

steps.action: Open the order and compare the line items and quantities with the source email.
steps.expected: Every line in the email exists on the order with the same item and quantity, and there are no extra lines.

steps.action: Record the sales order number with record_value and close the order without changing it.
steps.expected: The order is unchanged and no dialog is left open.
